aspect-ratio-calculator.name: Aspect Ratio Calculator
aspect-ratio-calculator.description: Simplify a width-to-height ratio and calculate proportional pixel dimensions for images, video, and layouts.

meta.title: Aspect Ratio Calculator
meta.description: Find the simplest aspect ratio of a resolution, scale to a target width or height, or fit within a bounding box.
meta.keywords: aspect ratio calculator, image dimensions, video resolution, proportional scaling, 16:9
